title: Gajveer Singh v. Power Corporation Limited
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Mahesh Chandra Tripathi, J. and Ajit Singh, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; EE to redress grievance in accordance with law.
headnote: Writ seeking a time-bound direction to install a 13 HP private tubewell connection after deposit of the estimate is disposed of, without any opinion on the merits, directing the Executive Engineer to look into the grievance and redress it in accordance with law within three weeks. The Court treated the Electricity Act, 2003 and the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as self-contained.
facts: The petitioner, resident of Village Valipur Athseli, District Farrukhabad, applied for a 13 HP private tubewell connection and deposited the estimated amount of Rs.1,43,559 on 16 November 2021. The connection was not released. His representation dated 13 December 2021 to the Executive Engineer, Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited, Kayamganj, remained unattended. He sought a writ directing installation of the connection within a stipulated period. The electricity department submitted that the Electricity Act, 2003 and the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 are self-contained and he could pursue the statutory remedy.

holding_units.topic: delayed new connection; consider grievance in accordance with law
holding_units.holding: Without expressing any opinion on the merits, and with the consent of the parties, the writ petition seeking a direction to install a 13 HP private tubewell connection after deposit of the estimate is disposed of with a direction to the Executive Engineer, Dakshinanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited, Kayamganj, District Farrukhabad to look into the petitioner's grievance and redress the same in accordance with law within three weeks of production of a certified copy of the order, the Court treating the Electricity Act, 2003 and the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 as self-contained.

principle_tags.application: The Court accepted that the Electricity Act, 2003 and the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 are self-contained, declined to decide the delayed-connection claim on merits, and directed the Executive Engineer to look into and redress the petitioner's grievance in accordance with law within three weeks.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner was entitled to release of the 13 HP private tubewell connection after depositing the estimated amount
not_decided.note: The Court expressly declined to express any opinion on the merits.
